(schema)  version=0
active  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Whether the user is active. The provider manages the whole status of the user through this attribute: `false` deactivates the user, `true` activates them. It defaults to `true`."
allowed_login_mode  ListAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "List of allowed login modes. Can include SSO, local authentication, or both."
    plan modifier: listplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
groups  SetAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "The ids of the groups the user belongs to, as decimal strings, the values SCIM returned in groups[].value. A user with no memberships has a known empty set."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "User ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  SingleNestedAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "The name of the user."
    plan modifier: objectplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name.family_name  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The family (last) name of the user."
name.given_name  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The given (first) name of the user."
user_name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Unique username"
